acceptanceCriteria.text: Discover local boards without crossing repository boundaries or choosing an unintended board.
Preserve explicit root behavior and report actionable diagnostics.
Document and test discovery, including nested repositories.

thread.body: Implemented repository-boundary board lookup and incomplete-board diagnostics; explicit root retains upward lookup. Full bun test: 270 pass, 0 fail. CLI executable discovery from nested directories still needs investigation and implementation.
